overview: droid-term is a portable setup script and environment bootstrapper that transforms an unconfigured Android device into a genuine, productive development workspace. Built specifically for developers who need to code on the go, it provisions essential CLI tools without requiring risky root access.
usecases: Quickly spinning up a functional Linux-like terminal on a tablet or backup phone while traveling without a laptop.
Running git operations, editing configuration files, and testing scripts directly from an Android device during an emergency bug fix.
Standardizing a secondary mobile development environment across multiple devices using a single automated script.
howto: Download the appbundle and install it alongside a standard Android terminal emulator like Termux.
Run the one-command environment check to verify system dependencies and storage permissions.
Execute the portable setup script to automatically pull and configure your core developer toolchain.

faq.q: Do I need to root my Android device to use this?
faq.a: No, droid-term runs entirely within user space and requires zero root privileges or system modifications.

faq.q: What actual packages and tools are included in the setup script?
faq.a: The script installs a curated set of standard POSIX utilities, git, curl, build-essential packages, and your choice of shell customization to ensure a familiar workflow.
